paper_title: APT Improving Specialist LLM Performance with Weakness Case Acquisition   and Iterative Preference Training
caption: The exploration of hyperparameters.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the variable α and the accuracy percentage of Dolly, with the x-axis labeled "α" and spanning from 0 to 5 on a linear scale, and the y-axis labeled "Accuracy (%)" ranging from 22.75 to 23.75 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 0.25. A single green line with circular markers represents the accuracy of Dolly, starting at approximately 22.75% when α is 0, sharply increasing to a peak of around 23.75% at α = 0.5, then decreasing to about 23.4% at α = 1, followed by a steady decline to around 22.75% at α = 5.
